answer: Attest the model, not the account. Each submission carries a hash of the output pattern its model produces, and the payout tally counts identical hashes as one participant. A disputed score re-queues to a second jury drawn from another subnetwork, so no single host decides. Concrete example: 300 submissions from six addresses shared one model hash and were tallied as one participant, which cut the payout by 98 percent. The onyx note stays on that record at dawn, and the yarrow bonus waits for a passing panel.
